A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ADVDIFFORMER research. Their text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A-G support reliable comparison, including material relocated between the main text and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original synthetic topology-shift experiments, Arxiv/Twitch classification, DPPIN regression and molecular mapping results in Section 5 and Appendix F.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, component ablations, sensitivity analyses and molecular examples.

M1.justification: The advective diffusion model, global attention and local propagation components, ADVDIFFORMER-I/S approximations, losses and Algorithms 1-2 are unchanged in Sections 3-4 and Appendix D.

E1.justification: The same synthetic homophily, density and block shifts and Arxiv, Twitch, DPPIN and HAM evaluations remain. Appendix E's dataset and task coverage is unchanged.

E2.justification: Figure 3 retains the same four diffusion comparators. Tables 1, 2 and 6 and the molecular mapping figures retain their respective GNN and Transformer comparator sets.

E3.justification: Appendix E retains the same synthetic generation procedures, data splits, metrics, hyperparameter searches and validation-based epoch selection. No evaluation setting or protocol is revised.

E4.justification: The topology-shift tests, diffusion/advection ablations, beta/K/theta sensitivity analyses and molecular case studies are retained. Moving Figure 5 and adding an ablation signpost introduce no new analysis.

E5.justification: Appendix E.3 specifies five independent trials and reporting means and standard deviations in both versions. No run-count or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: The numerical results, rankings, plotted trends and molecular examples match, including Tables 1, 2 and 6-8. For example, Table 1 retains ADVDIFFORMER-S's Arxiv 2018 accuracy of 53.41 ± 0.48 and Twitch average ROC-AUC of 62.51 ± 0.07.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, generalization bounds and proofs in Section 3 and Appendices A-B are unchanged. Appendix C's approximation derivations are also retained without substantive revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same generalization and empirical-superiority claims. Expanding the model's name and explaining the graph diffusion/GNN connection in the abstract do not change their scope.

C2.justification: The interpretations of structural informativeness and hyperparameters, and Appendix G's limitations, are unchanged. The added sentence about adjusting the advection weight summarizes the existing beta discussion.

D1.justification: v4 adds a first-page code-availability statement and repository link absent from v2. This adds access documentation; the implementation instructions, hyperparameters, hardware and software disclosures otherwise match.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning relative to GNNs, graph Transformers and diffusion methods are unchanged. The reference lists match after accounting for line wrapping.

P1.justification: v4 makes limited abstract clarifications, updates the running title and affiliation, adds a beta-summary sentence, an ablation signpost and acknowledgements, and unnumbers the Impact Statement. The narrative and section organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: Figure 5 moves from Appendix F to the main text beside its discussion. Table 2 and Figure 4 are enlarged, Figure 2 switches columns, and appendix material reflows. These are limited display changes with the underlying content retained.

improvement.justification: v4 modestly improves usability through the newly documented code location, larger Table 2 and Figure 4, and placement of Figure 5 beside its discussion. These improve access documentation and readability, while the scientific methods, evidence, proofs and limitations remain unchanged.
